observation: Stages 1-3 are healthy: orient_axis_corr -0.995 (invariant ok), recentre residual 1.9 cm (<< 10 cm gate), depth_nan_ratio 0.15 with voids confined to the top/bottom margins and one mid-map seam, denoise_retained_ratio 0.72 with spatially uniform discards. Detection shows exactly 10 verticals for 10 rings (ring_count_error 0) but very low oblique yield: only 4 positive-slope and 5 negative-slope segments over 10 rings, while many horizontals fire on bolt rows (y~430, 860, 1500 px) rather than joints. In detected_lines.png the oblique joints appear as faint dotted traces rather than continuous lines. Consequently 3/10 prompts are 'assume' fallbacks (det_real_detection_ratio 0.7, det_fallback_ratio 0.3) and correspondence_f1@15 is only 0.395: the sc overlay shows many orange joint lines unexplained by a label boundary and red unsupported K/B boundaries in the fallback columns (e.g. rings 4, 6, 9), plus sam_fill_rate 0.70 and sam_segment_size_cv 1.55.
rule: d7 (m_line_yield low AND horizontal fallback triggered) -> f_missing_lines, with likely_upstream f_joint_oversmoothed (d6: low joint contrast in the outlier map). Remediation r_lower_depth_threshold is unavailable in this bound set, so use the remaining stage-3 joint-densification knob (inter_radius) plus r_relax_hough (lower oblique threshold, raise maxLineGap, lower binarisation). f_depth_holes ruled out (NaN 0.15, no lining voids), so relaxing Hough is permitted by the r_relax_hough precondition. Verticals and denoise geometry are left untouched per experiences sec.4/sec.5 (ring count already exact; geometry knobs are transfer priors).
failure_mode: stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines (upstream stage_3_upsample.f_joint_oversmoothed) -> stage_5_segmentation.f_crop_offset on the 3 fallback rings
rationale: The proxy is in the refine band (0.646) and the weakest lean feature is correspondence_f1@15 (0.395), i.e. label boundaries do not sit on detected joints. Since orientation, centreline and band selection all validate, the tuning-order rule says the first legitimate target is detection. Raising inter_radius 0.06 -> 0.08 lets enhance_outlier_points bridge sparse joint points into denser, more continuous oblique traces in the outlier map; lowering binary_threshold to 115 keeps those fainter joint pixels after binarisation; lowering hough_threshold_oblique to 40 and raising maxLineGap_oblique to 60 lets HoughLinesP accept the dotted +-5-10 deg joints so more rings receive real positive/negative-slope intersections instead of 'assume' fallbacks. hough_threshold_horizontal is raised to 60 to suppress bolt-row horizontals that add no prompt information. Expected GT-free effect: det_real_detection_ratio 0.7 -> >=0.9, det_fallback_ratio -> <=0.1, correspondence_f1@15 up from 0.395, sam_fill_rate and segment_size_cv improving as K blocks land on true joints. Ring count must stay 10 (vertical threshold unchanged); if spurious oblique lines appear (prompt count inflation, d9) the next round should back off binary_threshold/hough_threshold_oblique toward 127/50.
